text: Implemented five deterministic visual QA fixtures through the public grammar/render-plan path: temporal scale plus coordinate zoom, typed style aesthetics, grouped ECDF, type-7 quantile summary, and aligned composition. Independent peers are ggplot2 for scale/style/stat semantics and ggplot2 plus patchwork for composition. Human review of the paired gallery caught and corrected temporal endpoint clipping, style boundary clipping, group-color ambiguity, and ggplot2 ECDF endpoint-padding mismatch. Added pinned Java2D goldens, full-image plus panel-focused perceptual checks, mutation sensitivity, an R peer renderer, HTML gallery tooling, a gated golden updater, and scope documentation. Verified end-to-end gallery generation; focused suite 3/3; bash syntax; git diff --check; and full scalafmtCheckAll testAll exit 0 with isolated sbt/coursier caches. External-repository name scan is clean.
